text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Seven people killed in Larbaa, south of Algiers.
- Planned talks between President Liamine Zeroual and party leaders over elections nurture hopes that a broaden dialogue may resume to tackle the Algerian crisis.
- Algeria faces the risk of seeing migratory fish being exterminated by foreign fishing boats.
- The National Transitional Council debates election law.
- President Zeroual holds talks with Syria's Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam over the Middle East peace process.
- Opposition parties want a neutral administration to ensure a fair and free election.
